newsitem.title: USA: Visa USA says debit-card transactions top one bln.
newsitem.headline: Visa USA says debit-card transactions top one bln.

text.p: Use of Visa debit cards was accelerating and total transactions using the cards drawing directly from checking accounts totalled more than one billion in 1996, a Visa USA executive said on Tuesday.

"We surpassed a billion check card transactions in 1996 -- that's about 31 debit transactions per second -- a 40 percent increase over 1995 and an almost 800 percent increase since 1991," executive vice president William Stewart told a trade group meeting here.
Stewart said more than 44 million Americans use debit cards, which resemble credit cards but take money immediately from a checking account rather constituting a loan.
